sagrada.name: Sagrada Familia
sagrada.price_text: ≈ €26–36 depending on tower access · book online
sagrada.hours: Roughly 09:00–18:00 in winter, later in summer · check on the day
sagrada.tip: Book a timed ticket weeks ahead. Go early morning for softer light through the stained glass.

guell.name: Park Güell
guell.price_text: ≈ €18 for the monumental zone · park outside is free
guell.hours: Daily, roughly 09:30–19:30 · check on the day
guell.tip: The ticketed zone is small; buy a slot and walk up from Lesseps metro to save the bus queue.
guell.best: Morning before the crowds and heat

rambla.name: La Rambla
rambla.tip: Walk it once for the buzz, then use the parallel streets for food and shopping. Watch your bag.
rambla.best: Morning or evening; avoid midday heat

batllo.name: Casa Batlló
batllo.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–20:00 · check on the day
batllo.tip: The rooftop and attic are the highlights. Book online to skip the street queue.

gotic.name: Gothic Quarter
gotic.tip: Get lost in the lanes north of the cathedral. Plaça Reial and the Roman walls are easy wins.

mila.name: Casa Milà (La Pedrera)
mila.price_text: ≈ €28 day visit · night rooftop tours cost more
mila.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–20:00 · check on the day
mila.tip: The rooftop chimneys are the star. Evening tours include the attic and a light show.

boqueria.name: Mercado de La Boqueria
boqueria.price_text: Free to enter · food priced per item
boqueria.tip: Eat at the back counters where locals go; the front stalls are for photos.

catedral.name: Barcelona Cathedral
catedral.hours: Daily, roughly 08:30–19:30 · check on the day
catedral.tip: The cloister geese and the rooftop walk are worth the small extra. Dress modestly.

campnou.name: Camp Nou
campnou.price_text: ≈ €28 museum and stadium tour · check current access
campnou.hours: Daily, hours vary with works · check on the day
campnou.tip: The stadium has been under renovation; confirm the tour route and match dates before you go.

arc.name: Arc de Triomf
arc.tip: Walk through to the Parc de la Ciutadella for a free, shady break.

aquarium.name: Barcelona Aquarium
aquarium.price_text: ≈ €25 adult · cheaper online and for children
aquarium.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–20:00 · check on the day
aquarium.tip: Good rainy-day option with kids. The glass tunnel is the highlight.

barceloneta.name: Barceloneta Beach
barceloneta.price_text: Free · sunbeds and umbrellas cost extra
barceloneta.tip: Go early to claim space. Keep valuables with you and use the showers before leaving.
barceloneta.best: Morning in summer; avoid peak August afternoons

liceu.name: Gran Teatre del Liceu
liceu.price_text: ≈ €15 guided tour · opera tickets from roughly €20
liceu.hours: Tours daily, times vary with rehearsals · check on the day
liceu.tip: Book a tour slot online; the horseshoe auditorium is the reason to go.

santpau.name: Hospital de Sant Pau
santpau.hours: Daily, roughly 09:30–18:30 · check on the day
santpau.tip: Quieter than the big Gaudí sites and just as beautiful. Pair it with Sagrada Familia on foot.

fountain.name: Magic Fountain of Montjuïc
fountain.hours: Evening shows on selected nights · check schedule on the day
fountain.tip: Shows have been limited in recent years; confirm before you plan an evening around it.

castell.name: Montjuïc Castle
castell.price_text: ≈ €5 entry · free on some Sunday afternoons
castell.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–20:00 in summer · check on the day
castell.tip: The harbour views from the moat are free. Take the cable car or bus up, walk down.

palau.name: Palau de la Música Catalana
palau.hours: Tours daily, times vary · check on the day
palau.tip: A concert here beats the tour if your dates fit. The stained-glass skylight is stunning.

upf.name: Pompeu Fabra University (Ciutadella campus)
upf.tip: Skip unless you have a reason to visit; the nearby Ciutadella park is the real draw.

teleferico.name: Teleférico del Puerto
teleferico.hours: Daily, roughly 11:00–19:00 · check on the day
teleferico.tip: Ride from the port to Montjuïc for the view, then walk down through the gardens.

tibidabo.name: Tibidabo Amusement Park
tibidabo.price_text: ≈ €35 day pass · cheaper for small children
tibidabo.hours: Seasonal, mostly weekends and summer · check on the day
tibidabo.tip: The old rides and the view over the city are the point. Bring a jacket, it is high and breezy.

ub.name: University of Barcelona (Historic Building)
ub.price_text: Free to see the facade and courtyard
ub.tip: Peek into the courtyard off Plaça Universitat; it is a calm five-minute stop.

bunkers.name: Bunkers del Carmel viewpoint
bunkers.tip: Best 360° view in the city. Bring water and go for sunset, but arrange your ride back.

gracia_walk.name: Gràcia neighbourhood walk
gracia_walk.tip: Small squares, local bars and few tourists. Wander Plaça del Sol and Plaça de la Virreina.

tapas_tour.name: Evening tapas and wine tour
tapas_tour.price_text: ≈ €60–90 per person · food and drinks included
tapas_tour.tip: Book a small-group tour to learn what to order. Confirm drinks are included in the price.

barceloneta_walk.name: Barceloneta and Port Vell waterfront walk
barceloneta_walk.tip: Walk from the Columbus statue along the marina to the beach. Good at sunset.

montjuic_walk.name: Montjuïc gardens and Olympic hill walk
montjuic_walk.price_text: Free · cable car and castle extra
montjuic_walk.tip: Take the bus up and walk down through the gardens to the Magic Fountain area.

santacaterina.name: Mercat de Santa Caterina
santacaterina.price_text: Free to enter · food priced per item
santacaterina.hours: Mon–Sat mornings to afternoon · closed Sunday
santacaterina.tip: Calmer than La Boqueria with the same fresh produce. Good for a cheap lunch counter.
